Subject: Re: Redshifts shifted after upgrade to lumenfit 2.5.0?

Please reopen this thread. The issue is real, it's in the library, and it is not my calibration or my config.

I did read the changelog. The only relevant line is "Refactor LineList and spectral frame handling (#812)". Nothing in that tells a user that a default changed.

I went through the PR 812 diff today. In LineList.__init__, the default went from wave_frame='air' to wave_frame='vacuum'. Rest wavelengths are now vacuum by default. My spectra are calibrated in air from arc lamps, so every line shifts by the air/vacuum ratio, about 1.00028 at H-alpha — roughly 83 km/s, which is exactly the offset I reported. There is no deprecation warning, and CHANGES.md does not mention it.

"Works fine for me" is not a test. If your data are already in vacuum, or you're fitting radio lines, you would see no difference at all. m_okonkwo reports a small offset on independent long-slit data in this same thread, so this isn't just my setup.

What it cost me: two days chasing a calibration problem that didn't exist, and I re-reduced arc lamps for 40 spectra for nothing.

Workaround for anyone else who lands here: pass wave_frame='air' explicitly, e.g. LineList(..., wave_frame='air'). That restores the 2.4.x behaviour. Worth pinning in configs until this is resolved.

What I'd ask for: reopen the thread, add a line to CHANGES.md stating that the default frame changed in 2.5.0, and either emit a warning when wave_frame isn't set explicitly or keep the old default and make vacuum opt-in. A single sentence in the changelog would have saved me two days.
